task_title: Expose rule resolution provenance in verdict
task_criteria: The engine returns rule_id and reason but not which layer won (engine builtin vs shipped YAML mirror vs user rule dir vs rule pack). Add a 'layer' field to InterceptResult (engine/yaml/user/pack) and populate it in Decider.evaluate() based on which rule source matched. Update plugin/test_interruptor.py to assert the layer field is present and correct for a builtin rule, a YAML mirror rule, and a user rule. Update the JSON bridge output in plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor_bridge.py to include the layer field. Run .venv/bin/python -m pytest plugin/test_interruptor.py -v and confirm all tests pass including the new layer assertions.
